ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 让你们久等了，抱歉

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
谢谢你，心玖。
我又知道了一件新的事情

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
贵安，吸・尘奇。
我是四宫宁月

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……只是这种程度的话我还是会弹的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
原来劳动是这么辛苦的事啊。
我也想做出更多贡献，可是……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 贵安

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 打扰了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 蕾叶，我洗好了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 嗯，试试看

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我也用演奏来出一份力吧。
唯独这点我有自信

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
没关系。
你呼吸平稳，稳稳站上了舞台

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 唔……这里就是Live House

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 到练习的时间了吗？我知道了，走吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 能做到的事情又变多了。多亏了Family的大家

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 第一次见到这种点心……不知道是什么味道

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 赏花时负责『占位』的角色……我想尝试一下

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 从商店街的人那里收到了草莓。这就是所谓的邻里分享吧……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 空调是有温度设定的，而且必须定在28℃。这是心玖教我的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这就是风铃啊……音色清凉，真好听

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我没有参加过运动会。据说是因为要保护手指

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 所谓挖红薯……是类似于丰收节一样的活动吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 被炉这种东西……很暖和……呼……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 收银台旁边的酒柜里，居然放着面包？便利店真是个不可思议的地方

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 圣诞老人肯定是存在的，就在这个世界的某个角落

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 新年要做的事……也就是去观看父亲的海外公演罢了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 心玖教过我，有一种给朋友发巧克力的文化

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 像这样被人庆祝生日，感觉还挺……新鲜的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 蕾叶生日快乐。今后也请多教教我关于Family的事

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 空调是有温度设定的，而且必须定在28℃。这是心玖教我的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 这就是风铃啊……音色清凉，真好听

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 我没有参加过运动会。据说是因为要保护手指

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 所谓挖红薯……是类似于丰收节一样的活动吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 被炉这种东西……很暖和……呼……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 收银台旁边的酒柜里，居然放着面包？便利店真是个不可思议的地方

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 圣诞老人肯定是存在的，就在这个世界的某个角落

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 新年要做的事……也就是去观看父亲的海外公演罢了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 心玖教过我，有一种给朋友发巧克力的文化

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 像这样被人庆祝生日，感觉还挺……新鲜的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.Text: 蕾叶生日快乐。今后也请多教教我关于Family的事

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 让你们久等了，抱歉

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text:
谢谢你，心玖。
我又知道了一件新的事情

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text:
贵安，吸・尘奇。
我是四宫宁月

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: ……只是这种程度的话我还是会弹的

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text:
原来劳动是这么辛苦的事啊。
我也想做出更多贡献，可是……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 贵安

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 打扰了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 蕾叶，我洗好了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 嗯，试试看

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text:
我也用演奏来出一份力吧。
唯独这点我有自信

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text:
没关系。
你呼吸平稳，稳稳站上了舞台

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 唔……这里就是Live House

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 到练习的时间了吗？我知道了，走吧

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 能做到的事情又变多了。多亏了Family的大家

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 第一次见到这种点心……不知道是什么味道

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
